title: (Quark Compat) Oh The Biomes We've Gone
description: Datapack adding chest compatibility between quark and OTBWG.
body:
**Oh The Biomes We've Gone + Quark Compatibility**  

**Description:**  
Datapack for **Minecraft Forge 1.20.1**. Adding compatibility between *[Oh The Biomes We've Gone!](https://modrinth.com/project/NTi7d3Xc)* and *[Quark](https://modrinth.com/project/qnQsVE2z)*, fixing the recipe which stopped players from crafting chests using the modded woods from *Oh The Biomes We've Gone!* when Quark's chest recipes are added.

**Features:**  
- Craft chests from **modded woods** provided by *OTBWG*  
- Works with **Quark chest recipes**  
- Compatible with **Forge 1.20.1**
